name: Sliding window
intuition: Keep a running summary of a stretch of consecutive items and update it from what enters and leaves.

variants.name: Fixed size
variants.summary: The window always holds exactly k items and slides one step at a time.
variants.requires: Only that k is fixed. It works with negative values too.

variants.name: Variable size
variants.summary: Grow the right edge, and shrink the left edge while a condition is broken.
variants.requires: A monotone condition: shrinking must never break a valid window. For sums this usually means no negative values.

variants.name: Window with a sorted queue
variants.summary: Keep candidates for the window's best in a queue that stays in order, dropping ones that can never win.
variants.requires: A newer item can make an older one useless for every future window.

visual.caption: Sliding one step drops the day on the left and adds the day on the right. The days in between never need adding again.
